Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “Having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you” - How Trinity Rodman rose above Dennis Rodman’s shadow, lived in motels, and built her own soccer legacy
Article Text:
Inspiring story of the day: “Having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you” - How Trinity Rodman rose above Dennis Rodman’s shadow, lived in motels, and built her own soccer legacy

How did Trinity Rodman live in a car despite being Dennis Rodman’s daughter

Call Her Daddy

What did Trinity Rodman say about her relationship with Dennis Rodman

Why does Trinity Rodman call Michelle Moyer her role model?

How did Trinity Rodman turn a difficult childhood into a soccer career

Why is Trinity Rodman’s story inspiring beyond soccer

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Trinity Rodman has built a soccer career that now stands on its own. The Washington Spirit star is a 2024 Olympic gold medalist, a 2021 NWSL champion and, as of January 2026, the highest-paid player in NWSL history. But her childhood looked very different from what many people expected from the daughter of NBA legend Dennis Rodman . Trinity and her brother DJ once lived with their mother, Michelle Moyer, in a Ford Expedition and cheap motels in Newport Beach. Through those difficult years, Michelle kept life feeling normal for her children. That bond helped shape Trinity into the player she is today.Having a famous father did not mean Trinity Rodman grew up with an easy life. After Dennis Rodman and Michelle Moyer separated, Trinity, her brother DJ and their mother faced serious money problems. For a period, they moved between a Ford Expedition and motels when Michelle could afford a room.The situation was especially strange because they were living in Newport Beach, where Trinity went to a wealthy school. She has spoken about seeing classmates arrive in expensive cars while her own family was trying to work out where they would stay.On, Trinity explained just how unusual those years were:“We had a Ford Expedition and we lived in that for a little bit. Mind you, in Newport Beach… So imagine living in a car going to a rich school when everybody else is in Rolls-Royces and Range Rovers. But my mom tried to make every situation seem smoother than it actually was. For me and DJ, it was never embarrassing because we had each other and we had our mom.”For Trinity and DJ, however, those memories were not only painful. Their mother tried hard to make sure they still had happy childhood moments. At motels, they could eat breakfast, use the pool and spend time together before school. That helped the children see their family life differently from how an outsider might have seen it.Trinity’s relationship with Dennis Rodman has remained one of the most talked-about parts of her story, but it has also been one of the most painful. She has said that her father was often absent while she was growing up and that there were long periods when they had little contact.That distance became impossible to ignore as Trinity began making a name for herself in soccer. Instead of being known only as an athlete, she was repeatedly asked about being Dennis Rodman’s daughter.She later spoke openly about how difficult that connection could feel:“He’s a person. He’s not a dad. Maybe by blood, but nothing else… Hearing his voice is painful because it’s missing him mixed with the fact that he’s an alcoholic. I answer the phone now for my conscience, but it took me a long time to realize that having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you. I had to build everything myself.”Dennis has also publicly admitted that he was not the father he wanted to be. At his Basketball Hall of Fame induction, he said he wished he had been a better father.For Trinity, though, her own career could not depend on her father’s reputation. Her speed, finishing, attacking ability and work on the field became the things that made people remember her.If Dennis Rodman gave Trinity a famous last name, Michelle Moyer gave her the support that helped her grow into a professional athlete. Michelle raised Trinity and DJ largely as a single mother and remained closely involved in Trinity’s soccer journey.The Guardian reported in 2021 that Trinity saw her mother as her main support system. That feeling has remained central to how she talks about her childhood and her success.Trinity Rodman put it simply:“My mom wasn’t in the NBA, but she’s my role model. She is my world, my rock, and my right hand. She’s the strongest person I know. People always say, ‘Oh, you get your athleticism from your dad,’ but my work ethic, my heart, my grit, and the woman I am today-that’s 100% my mom.”That is an important part of Trinity Rodman’s story because her biggest influence was not another famous athlete. It was the person who was there when money was tight, when the family had nowhere stable to stay and when Trinity was still only a young girl trying to understand her world.Trinity’s soccer career moved quickly once she reached the professional level. She entered the NWSL with the Washington Spirit in 2021 and became the youngest player ever selected in the league’s draft at the time. She went on to win the NWSL Rookie of the Year award and helped the Spirit win the league championship that same year.Her rise continued with the U.S. women’s national team. She became an important attacking player for the USWNT and was part of the squad that won Olympic gold at the 2024 Paris Games.The success also changed the way her name was viewed. Instead of being introduced mainly as Dennis Rodman’s daughter, Trinity became a major soccer star in her own right.In January 2026, she reached another major point in her career when she re-signed with the Washington Spirit on a deal worth more than $2 million per year. The agreement made her the highest-paid player in NWSL history.That achievement says a lot about how far she has come. The girl who once went to school after sleeping in a car is now one of the biggest names in American women’s soccer.Trinity Rodman’s story is not simply about becoming famous despite having a difficult childhood. It is about how she chose to define herself.She could have spent her career being introduced through her father’s name. Instead, she has built an identity around her own performances and the people who stood beside her. Her mother remained a constant presence, while soccer gave Trinity a place where her effort could speak for itself.Her journey also explains why the success means more than trophies and contracts. The Olympic gold medal, NWSL championship and record-breaking deal are major achievements, but they came after years of work that had little to do with her father’s fame.Trinity has been clear about that point herself: a famous parent can give someone a name, but it cannot do the training, handle the pressure or play the game for them.For Trinity Rodman, the most important part of her legacy may be that she did not allow her father’s story to become her own. She took the difficult parts of her childhood, held on to the support her mother gave her and built a career that now belongs completely to her.
Article Summary: Trinity rodman has built a soccer career that now stands on its own. The washington spirit star is a 2024 olympic gold medalist, a 2021 nwsl champion and the highest-paid player in nwsl history. But her childhood looked very different from what many people expected from the daughter of nba legend dennis rodman.

Article Title: Trinity Rodman’s painful revelation about father Dennis Rodman resurfaces: ‘Extremely selfish human being’
Article Text:
Trinity Rodman’s painful revelation about father Dennis Rodman resurfaces: ‘Extremely selfish human being’

Trinity Rodman says Dennis Rodman was absent from her life

Why Trinity Rodman still remembers the 2021 playoff game

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Trinity Rodman’s comments about her father Dennis Rodman are back in the spotlight after an X account shared a clip from her 2024 Call Her Daddy interview. The US soccer star spoke openly about their strained relationship and said Dennis was not a real father figure in her life. She also recalled a 2021 playoff game when he appeared without warning. Rodman said the visit affected her so much that she cried during the game. The old clip is now drawing fresh attention to what she said about her childhood and her relationship with him.In the December 18, 2024 episode of Call Her Daddy with Alex Cooper, Rodman gave her most detailed account of the relationship. She said she had tried to protect her father publicly for years, but felt she could no longer hide how much his absence had affected her.“He’s an extremely selfish human being… I think everything has always been about him,” Rodman said. She then made her view clear: “He’s not a dad. Maybe by blood, but nothing else.”Rodman said she wanted a real father-daughter bond. She spoke about wanting a genuine hug from him and said hearing his voice could bring up feelings connected to missing him and the hurt she carried. She also said she sometimes answered his calls mainly so she could feel she had done the right thing, rather than because she wanted to rebuild the relationship.Rodman has also described financial hardship after her parents’ split, including periods when the family lived in a Ford Expedition and motels. She has credited her mother as the main source of support while she built her soccer career.Rodman also talked about a moment from her rookie season in 2021, when Dennis unexpectedly appeared at a Washington Spirit playoff game. She said she had not spoken with him for months, and realizing he was there brought up emotions she could not control.“The whistle blew and I was so mad,” she recalled. “You took this happy moment from me. You f**ked with my head again.”Rodman said she later confronted him, telling him, “F**k you,” before crying in his arms “as if it’s a daddy-daughter [moment].” She questioned whether his appearance was really about supporting her or being seen at the game.Rodman hoped the meeting could lead to a closer relationship. Instead, she said they returned to having little contact.Dennis Rodman later responded publicly, saying he was sorry he had not been the father she wanted and insisting that he still tried to be there for her. Rodman rejected the response on Instagram Stories, calling it “A joke” and adding, “Wiping my hands with it. I’m done. Thank you.”The latest X post is recirculating an old interview, not revealing a new account from Rodman. The original comments came from her December 2024 conversation with Alex Cooper, where she spoke about a relationship that had remained painful and distant for years.

Us soccer star spoke openly about their strained relationship and said dennis was not a real father figure in her life. She also recalled a 2021 playoff game when he appeared without warning. Rodman said the visit affected her so much that she cried during the game.

Article Title: How Kenneth Walker is quietly becoming the most important player on the Chiefs' roster
Article Text:
Kenneth Walker is one of the most important Chiefs players at present (Getty Images)

Why is Kenneth Walker the Chiefs' most important player right now?

What makes Kenneth Walker different from every other Chief running back in recent memory?

How does Walker's role with the Chiefs compare to his time in Seattle?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Kenneth Walker had 14 carries for 89 yards in the first half of Kansas City's Week 1 matchup against the Denver Broncos. He set up a Mahomes touchdown on the opening drive. Then added two receptions. Then a 28-yard carry that was the longest play of the game. For a Chiefs team returning from a 6-11 collapse and a quarterback still finding his footing after ACL surgery, Walker did not just contribute. He carried the offense. And that was only the first half.Patrick Mahomes is the name on the marquee, but Walker is the reason this offense functions. That sounds like an overstatement. It isn't. When the Chiefs signed Walker to a three-year deal worth up to $45 million in March, the move was framed as a backfield upgrade. What it actually was, was a structural fix.Kansas City has not had a 1,000-yard rusher since Mahomes took over as the starting quarterback. That is a stunning gap for a team that won multiple Super Bowls. The passing game covered it up for years. Then Mahomes tore his ACL in Week 15 of 2025, the Chiefs went 6-11, and suddenly the absence of a credible ground game was impossible to ignore.Walker is also reviving something that had gone dormant in Andy Reid's offense for years: the screen game.During Reid's early tenure with Kansas City, Jamaal Charles gave him the personnel to run one of the most dangerous screen attacks in the NFL. That element has been absent since. Walker, who told Kay Adams he had been working directly with Mahomes to build passing game chemistry, averaged fewer than 40 catches per season in Seattle. That number is expected to jump considerably here.According to Jesse Newell of The Athletic, Reid opened up his screen-game playbook in training camp and Walker was the primary target, flashing strong receiving skills and even occasional one-handed catches.Walker forced 77 missed tackles across the 2025 regular season and playoffs, trailing only Bijan Robinson over that span, while earning a 91.4 PFF grade. He has improved his overall PFF grade every single season of his career. That kind of consistency is rare. So is his running style.At his July training camp press conference, Walker explained how patience and explosiveness coexist in his game. "I would just believe over the years running the ball since growing up, and just working with my pops, just seeing the defense is I believe that's how I really learned how to be patient or, you know, explosive. It just depends on what the play is, honestly," Walker said. "I feel like that helps the O-Line...whatever they need me to do, that's what I'm gonna do. "The Chiefs have no real competition for passing-down work behind Walker. After waiving Emari Demercado, the remaining backs on the roster are Emmett Johnson, a Day 3 rookie, and Brashard Smith, a gadget player without the size to reliably block. The result is a roster built around giving Walker every snap they can justify.The Chiefs internally view Walker as a three-down back. That is not a label Kansas City has applied to a running back in a long time.This is where context matters. Walker spent four years in Seattle largely underused, splitting touches with Zach Charbonnet and never fully earning a bell-cow role until Charbonnet's knee injury forced the Seahawks' hand late in the 2025 season. His usage in Seattle prior to that injury was likely a team preference rather than any reflection on Walker himself.In Super Bowl LX, Walker ran for 135 yards on 27 carries with two receiving touchdowns as Seattle defeated New England 29-13. He became the first running back to win Super Bowl MVP since Terrell Davis did it for Denver in Super Bowl XXXII.Kansas City did not sign a complementary piece. They signed a player whose ceiling had been artificially suppressed for years. The difference is real. In Seattle, Walker worked within a system that never fully committed to him.In Kansas City, the system is being designed around what he does.Week 1 against Denver was one data point. But the role, the contract, the scheme, and the 28-yard burst that stopped a stadium cold in the first half all point toward the same thing. Walker is not a piece of the Chiefs' rebuild. He is the foundation of it.
Article Summary: Kenneth walker had 14 carries for 89 yards in the first half of kansas city's week 1 matchup against the denver broncos. The chiefs signed walker to a three-year deal worth up to $45 million in march. Walker spent four years in seattle largely underused, splitting touches with zach charbonnet.

It has been a while but the wait is over. Kawhi Leonard is in the Toronto Raptors again, and the trade reuniting him with the franchise he led to a championship in 2019 is no longer hypothetical. The Raptors and Clippers received league approval Monday to finalize the deal both sides shook hands on back in late June, ending a stretch where an already-completed trade sat frozen because of an active NBA investigation.Nothing about the trade package changed in the two and a half months it spent in limbo. The Clippers still get Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and a stack of draft compensation, and the Raptors still get their franchise cornerstone back. What changed is the context: the NBA's probe into how the Clippers paid Leonard is now closed, complete with penalties that reshaped the roster math on both sides.Kawhi Leonard's return closes a loop that started when he left Toronto for the Clippers after that 2019 title run, still the only championship of his career.Raptors general manager Bobby Webster called it a statement move for a franchise trying to get back into contention, saying Leonard's "impact on our organization, our city and our country is undeniable."Leonard framed the moment as a reset after a turbulent offseason, saying he's "focused on what I can control, closing this chapter." At 35, he's coming off the best statistical season of his career, a career-high 27.9 points across 65 games for the Clippers last year, along with 6.4 rebounds and 3.6 assists.The trade framework has been the same from what the two sides agreed in June. Toronto sends Leonard west and gets back a package built almost entirely on draft capital: two unprotected first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, a first-round pick swap in 2027, and second-round picks in 2030 and 2033.The Clippers get two rotation pieces in return. Ingram, extended to a three-year, $120 million deal shortly after Toronto acquired him, averaged 21.5 points, 4.8 rebounds and 3.7 assists last season. Dick, the Raptors' 2023 first-round pick, saw his role shrink, with his scoring dropping to 6.0 points per game on 30% 3-point shooting.The agreement sat frozen because the NBA was investigating whether the Clippers circumvented the salary cap when they signed Leonard to that three-year, $103 million deal in July 2019, reportedly including a no-show job worth $28 million. Both franchises agreed not to finalize the trade until the league closed its probe. The findings landed hard: Ballmer drew a one-year suspension and a $30 million fine, and the team forfeited five first-round picks. Leonard himself was fined $700,000, though the league didn't suspend him or void his contract. As for his fortune, Leonard is estimated to have earned approximately $375.8 million in NBA salary through the end of the 2026-27 season.Ballmer has already said he won't challenge the punishment. For Leonard, the next milestone is a contract extension with Toronto, something the Clippers weren't willing to offer. Toronto hosts the Clippers in a preseason game in Vancouver on Oct. 10, the Raptors visit Los Angeles on Nov. 2, and the Clippers head to Toronto on Jan. 1.
Article Summary: Clippers traded kawhi leonard to the raptors. The clippers still get brandon ingram, gradey dick and a stack of draft compensation. The nba's probe into how the clippers paid leonard is now closed, complete with penalties that reshaped the roster math on both sides.

Article Title: What did Peyton Manning say after Bo Nix’s costly interception? Denver Broncos suffer heartbreaking 31-10 loss to Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs
Article Text:
What did Peyton Manning say after Bo Nix’s costly interception? (Getty Images)

Peyton Manning breaks down the interception that gave Chiefs an early opening

Bo Nix quickly answered Peyton Manning’s concern

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Bo Nix’s return to the Denver Broncos lineup could hardly have started worse. On Monday, Nix threw an interception on Denver’s first passing attempt against the Kansas City Chiefs, leaving Peyton Manning visibly stunned during the ManningCast.The Hall of Fame quarterback watched Nix’s comeback from the ManningCast booth with his brother Eli Manning. Nix had not played a regular-season game since fracturing his ankle in Denver’s AFC Divisional Round win over Buffalo last season, and his first series at Arrowhead Stadium quickly gave Manning something to react to.The problem started before Nix even got a chance to settle into the game. He took a sack on Denver’s opening play, ran on the second play and then dropped back on third down looking for Courtland Sutton.Chiefs rookie Mansoor Delane jumped the route and intercepted Nix, giving Kansas City possession at the Denver 46-yard line. Manning immediately reacted during the ManningCast alternate broadcast on ESPN2.“Oh, no, no, no, no,” Manning said during the Sept. 14 ManningCast while reacting to the interception.The Mannings then went through the coverage. Peyton initially read the play as a two-man look, while Eli pointed out that Kansas City actually had a single-high safety.Eli felt Delane guessed on the route and nearly stumbled into the interception.Peyton then explained why he viewed the play as a fortunate break for the rookie cornerback.“He’s lucky he ran the in route, because the trail technique without a safety help over the top, if you go deep, it’s going to be wide open,” Manning said during the ManningCast. “He really lucks out on that play.”That gave the Chiefs a chance to turn Nix’s mistake into points, and they did exactly that. Kenneth Walker III carried the ball seven times for 32 yards on the drive before Patrick Mahomes finished it with a 15-yard touchdown run.Nix did not let the interception define his return. Denver’s next possession looked completely different, with the quarterback completing all five of his passes for 55 yards and ending the drive with a 19-yard touchdown pass to tight end Evan Engram. The score tied the game at 7-7.Manning acknowledged the response while continuing to point out how fortunate Delane had been on the earlier play. “He should have guessed right,” Manning said during the ManningCast. “Pretty good start to his career, Eli.”Nix’s quick response offered Denver an early lift, but the Broncos could not keep pace with Kansas City. The Chiefs eventually pulled away for a 31-10 victory at Arrowhead Stadium on September 14.The result also flipped the script from 2025. Denver had swept Kansas City in both meetings last season and won the AFC West for the first time in a decade. This time, Mahomes and the Chiefs opened the new season with a convincing win while Nix’s comeback began with one interception that had Peyton Manning shaking his head.
Article Summary: Bo nix threw an interception on denver’s first passing attempt against the kansas city chiefs. Nix had not played a regular-season game since fracturing his ankle last season. The chiefs eventually pulled away for a 31-10 victory at arrowhead stadium.

Article Title: Josh Hokit wants Ciryl Gane after Tom Aspinall vacates UFC title, while Josh Thomson backs his controversial plan
Article Text:
Josh Hokit wants Ciryl Gane after Tom Aspinall vacates UFC title, while Josh Thomson backs his controversial plan

Josh Hokit wants Ciryl Gane after Tom Aspinall vacates UFC title

Josh Thomson backs Josh Hokit’s Ciryl Gane title plan

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Tom Aspinall’s decision to vacate the UFC heavyweight title has quickly changed the picture at the top of the division. With Aspinall stepping away because of his ongoing eye problems, Josh Hokit has already put forward his own plan. He wants to fight Ciryl Gane next and believes Alex Pereira should earn another win at heavyweight before getting a title shot. Former UFC fighter Josh Thomson seemed to like the idea, replying simply, “Take My Money.”Aspinall announced on September 14 that he was giving up the heavyweight belt because he could not get medical clearance to fight. His latest eye injury has forced him to put his return on hold, leaving the UFC heavyweight division without its champion.The timing puts Gane in a strong position. Gane was already the interim heavyweight champion after his fight with Aspinall ended in a no contest at UFC 321 in October 2025. Aspinall could not continue after suffering eye pokes during the bout.Hokit now wants the UFC to move forward with him and Gane.“The fans deserve Me vs Gane. I’ll give Ciryl what he has coming. If Alex can win 1 fight in my weight class, I’ll give it to him too, early ‘27.I’ll be the most active champ in the company.”The message makes Hokit’s plans pretty clear. He wants Gane next, but he is also leaving the door open for Pereira if the former light heavyweight champion can first pick up a win at heavyweight.Hokit has also been clear that he does not think Pereira should walk straight into another title fight. He shared his view in a post aimed at both Pereira and Ilia Topuria.“Growing up, I loved the @ufc & all of its fighters. So it gives me great pleasure to use my platform today to speak the truth. Neither Ilia Topuria nor Alex Pereira deserve a fu*king title shot in their next fight. They both got handily destroyed. Make them earn it and fight their way back like everyone else. Sincerely, The Fans.”That stance has now received a short but strong reaction from Thomson. The former UFC fighter responded to Hokit’s proposed plan with just three words: “Take My Money.”Thomson did not add a long explanation, but his reaction makes it clear that he likes the idea of seeing Hokit and Gane share the cage.For Hokit, the next step is straightforward. He wants the UFC to book him against Gane for the heavyweight title, while Pereira would have to prove himself in the division first.There is no official announcement yet for Gane’s next fight. But with Aspinall no longer holding the belt, Hokit has wasted no time putting his name forward for the biggest opportunity in the division.
Article Summary: Josh hokit wants to fight ciryl gane after tom aspinall vacates ufc title. Former light heavyweight champion believes alex pereira should earn another win at heavyweight before getting a title shot. Former ufc fighter josh thomson backs hokit's controversial plan.

Article Title: 'I'm tired of this': Indian wushu player Divyanshi Choudhary breaks down on hostel roof after Asian Games axing
Article Text:
Divyanshi Choudhary (Image credit: Instagram)

Father questions last-minute decision

What Wushu body said

Federation explains Roshibina’s selection

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Indian wushu player Divyanshi Choudhary was looking forward to making her Asian Games debut in Nagoya. However, just days before the event, the 18-year-old was dropped from the Indian squad.Divyanshi had been sharing her excitement on social media as the Games approached. She posted pictures of her kit and also shared moments from the Indian team’s send-off ceremony in New Delhi.Her latest video, however, showed a very different side. Standing on the roof of her hostel at the National Institute of Sports in Patiala, Divyanshi was seen in tears as she spoke about being left out of the team.She said she was removed from the women’s 60kg category and replaced by Roshibina Devi Naorem, whom she had beaten in the selection trials.“I’m tired of this... I have been mentally harassed so much. Since June, July, they have been after me because she (Roshibina) wanted to go. Given that I beat her, why is it a problem for her now,” Divyanshi said in the video.“I beat her, it’s my right to go there (Japan). She has been knocking at different doors...it’s abuse of power,” she added.Divyanshi’s father, Sunil, said the family was informed about the decision only on Friday morning.He claimed that they were not given any reason for her removal.He also alleged that Divyanshi was supposed to be told about the decision only after reaching the airport, when she would have been informed that she was not travelling with the team.Sunil also questioned the decision to replace Divyanshi with Roshibina, a world medallist, two-time Asian medallist and Arjuna awardee.“Divyanshi beat Roshibina in the semifinals of the trials. If the association had to send someone, they should have sent the individual who Divyanshi beat in the final,” Sunil told Sportstar.ID@undefined Caption not available.ID@undefined Caption not available.ID@undefined Caption not available.The Wushu Association of India has rejected the allegations. Its president Jitender Bajwa said the federation was not responsible for removing Divyanshi from the squad.Bajwa said the Sports Authority of India (SAI) took the decision after an injury was discovered.“Divyanshi joined the national camp which was organised by SAI a month back. She was carrying a knee injury and was trying to hide it by avoiding training. When SAI eventually found out about this, the replaced her name,” Bajwa told Sportstar.Divyanshi’s father admitted that she had suffered an injury but said she was undergoing treatment.“After she got an injury, we got Divyanshi checked by a doctor. She had an injury to her ACL (Anterior Cruiciate ligament). The doctor said it could be treated by rehabilitation,” Sunil said.Bajwa said the coaches at the national camp noticed that Divyanshi was not training and recommended that she undergo a medical examination.“The coaches in the camp had recommended that Divyanshi be checked for an injury because she was not training. Eventually, the coaches informed SAI which arranged for a medical test which showed she was carrying a knee injury. They couldn’t carry an injured athlete to the Asian Games so they had to remove her name,” he said.Bajwa also explained why Roshibina was chosen despite losing to Divyanshi in the selection trials.He said Himanshi of Chandigarh, who lost in the final, had suffered a jaw fracture and was therefore unavailable as a replacement.“The losing finalist, Himanshi of Chandigarh, suffered a fracture to her jaw which is why her name was not included. Instead the coaches had already recommended the name of Roshibina Devi as the replacement player for Divyanshi,” Bajwa said.Bajwa said the federation was also disappointed that Divyanshi would miss the Asian Games.“She is a very talented athlete. She performed very well at the trials. It is bad luck that she will not be going to the Asian Games,” he said.
Article Summary: Divyanshi choudhary was looking forward to making her asian games debut in nagoya. The 18-year-old was dropped from the indian squad just days before the event. She said she was removed from the women’s 60kg category and replaced by roshibina devi naorem. Roshibina was chosen despite losing to divyanshi in the selection trials.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge
Article Text:
El Rubius reacted honestly after his elimination from MrBeast’s $1 million challenge, calling it “unfair” and claiming he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings. His response felt real and balanced, especially after MrBeast’s team later sent him a cake, softening the moment.

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

El Rubius did not just walk away from MrBeast’s $1 million streamer challenge. He opened up. Soon after his elimination, the Spanish creator shared a raw reaction with fans, giving them a closer look at what the experience felt like from inside the game. It was not polished or carefully framed. It felt real, and that is exactly why it caught attention so quickly.The clip and his response have since fueled conversations across the streaming space. Some viewers believe intense competitions like this naturally lead to uneven situations. Others feel Rubius may have had a point about being singled out. Either way, his words have added a human layer to a challenge that many only saw as entertainment.Speaking through an Instagram Story, Rubius did not hide his frustration, but he also made sure to thank his supporters. He said, "Guys, I just got knocked out of the game. It was a bit of an unfair elimination, but hey, at least I managed to walk away with $50,000 for you all, which I’ve already distributed. It went to the mods, the subs, and the non-subs alike."He further added, "I’m happy, of course, though admittedly, it was incredibly tough.I wasn't really a fan of the challenge itself, either. But then again... it was basically a three-against-one situation the entire time. I mean, they were targeting me specifically the whole way through. I kept trying to go after RaKai, but, well, he actually just got eliminated in the end. So, at least justice was served for Abraham. Abraham, if you’re watching this, we were all rooting for you, and standing right there with you."His message carried mixed emotions. There was disappointment, yes, but also pride in how he handled things. Giving away his $50,000 winnings to his community stood out as a gesture that meant more than the result itself.He continued with another honest note, saying, "And in the end, karma finally caught up with that little punk. Sorry, I’m being a bit toxic right now, but let's just hope the MrBeast team doesn't see this! Guys, thank you all so much. Seriously, thank you for all the support and for just being there."He added, "Every time I asked for something in the chat or whatever it was, you guys were right there. You’re incredible. I’m a little disappointed in myself, personally, mostly for not performing better, but hey, I gave it my all, and we still walked away with $50,000, so we’ve got to look on the bright side. All right, guys, big hugs to all my brothers out there!"Interestingly, the story did not end with frustration. Later that day, Rubius revealed that MrBeast’s team had sent him a cake after his exit. It was a small gesture, but it shifted the mood. It showed that even in a high-pressure challenge, there is still room for respect.In the end, Rubius’ reaction felt honest and grounded. That is what stayed with people.
Article Summary: El rubius was eliminated from mrbeast's $1 million challenge. He called it "unfair" and said he was targeted in a three-against-one situation. Despite his frustration, he thanked fans and gave away his $50,000 winnings.

RCB register their second win

NEW DELHI: IPL comes and the demand for tickets and passes go soaring up by the fans. The desperation to get inside the stadium to watch their favourite teams in action in the IPL go high and high. When the tickets get sold out, the demand gets too hig, and the cricket fans even ask for tickets in black. But for a 25-year-old techie the craze for IPL tickets for RCB vs CSK turned too costly and he was duped for a massive Rs. 1.46 lakh.The techie, a resident of B Narayanapura, fell into a trap by a post posted by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram.As per a report in Deccan Herald, the techie alleged in a complaint to Mahadevapura Police that an individual claiming to be Sumit Biswal promised he could arrange IPL tickets along with food coupons.As per the techie, Biswal was introduced him as a senior supervisor for ticket counter at M Chinnaswamy Stadium"He asked me to come near the stadium gate number 10, saying someone would deliver the tickets within minutes, and even sent an email confirmation to gain my trust," the complainant told Deccan Herald."Initially, I agreed to buy two tickets for Rs 3,700 each,but he kept asking for more money under various pretexts such as refundable security deposits, additional ID cards and food coupons.Trusting him, I made multiple payments - even using my mother’s bank account after exhausting my own limits—and ended up transferring around Rs 1.46 lakh," he added.Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s incisive spell of 3-41, coming after a marauding batting show from Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal, propelled Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to a commanding 43-run victory over Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in their IPL 2026 encounter at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday.The contest saw RCB’s batting unit dismantle CSK’s attack with relentless hitting, as David’s 70 not out off just 25 balls and Patidar’s unbeaten 48 off only 19 balls provided for the late fireworks after Padikkal’s fluent 50 off 29 balls had set the tone for the daunting total.Their combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026. In reply, CSK faltered under scoreboard pressure, with Sarfaraz Khan’s 50 off 24 balls and Prashant Veer’s 43 the lone acts of resistance amid a string of failures from the top order.Bhuvneshwar was at his disciplined best and even crossed the 200-mark in terms of wickets in IPL, with others also chipping in as CSK were bowled out for 207 in 19.4 overs. The comprehensive win also meant RCB have registered four consecutive triumphs over CSK for the first time in the IPL’s history.
Article Summary: Royal challengers bengaluru (rcb) beat chennai super kings (csk) in ipl 2026 encounter at the m chinnaswamy stadium. Tim david, rajat patidar and devdutt padikkal hit 70, 48 and 50 respectively to lift rcb to 250/3. Bhuvneshwar kumar took 3-41 as csk were bowled out for 207 in 19.4 overs.

Article Title: Shattering records and cultivating future stars
Article Text:
Mayura Shanbaug

Ashish Kumar Srivastava - MD and CEO of PNB MetLife

Sameer Bansal - Chief Distribution Officer of PNB MetLife

Chirag Shetty - Asian Games Gold Medalist & JBC 2023 mentor

Satwiksairaj Rankireddy - Asian Games Gold Medalist & JBC 2023 mentor

Disclaimer: Content Produced by PNB Metlife

The 7th PNB MetLife Junior Badminton Championship shattered records with over 8,200 young talent nationwide, earning global recognition and fostering a culture of resilience and determination in aspiring badminton starsIn a spectacular display of badminton prowess and youthful enthusiasm, the 7th edition of the PNB MetLife Junior Badminton Championship (JBC) etched its name in the annals of sporting history. Celebrating a staggering participation of 8257 young champions from across India, the championship not only broke its own record set in 2022 but also clinched the title of the ‘Most kids participating in a Badminton Championship in multiple cities’ as recognised by the World Record Certification Agency (WRCA).The grand finale unfolded at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi, where the air was thick with competition, camaraderie, and the unmistakable passion for badminton. The event, graced by chief guests Chirag Shetty and Satwik Rankireddy, Asian Games Gold Medalists and JBC 2023 mentors, was a true celebration of the sport’s rising stars.The 10-city extravaganza, spanning the length and breadth of the country, showcased the unwavering commitment of PNB MetLife in nurturing young talents in the badminton arena. With participants exceeding 8200, it’s evident that the PNB MetLife JBC has become a beacon for aspiring shuttlers, highlighting the deep-seated passion for badminton among the diverse and talented youth of India.Beyond the glitz and glamour of the record-breaking numbers, the championship holds a special place in the hearts of those at the helm. Ashish Kumar Srivastava, MD and CEO of PNB MetLife, expressed pride in not just surpassing their own world record but also in contributing to India’s glory on the international badminton stage. The championship, he emphasized, is not merely a competition but a significant milestone in creating a pan-India badminton ecosystem.This edition of the JBC saw a strategic partnership with world champions Chirag Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, who served as mentors for the young talents. Sameer Bansal, Chief Distribution Officer of PNB MetLife, acknowledged the pivotal role played by these champions in inspiring the next generation of badminton stars. The focus, according to Bansal, is on unleashing the latent potential of young shuttlers and preparing them for global excellence.The Delhi chapter of the championship witnessed some nail-biting action with over 1000 participants competing fiercely across various categories. From Ananya Talyan’s stellar performance in Girls Singles Under 9 to Divyansh Rawat’s triumph in Boys Singles Under 17, the young talents left no shuttle unturned in their quest for victory.The results from the Delhi leg not only showcased the raw talent but also highlighted the championship’s commitment to breaking barriers. The PNB MetLife Junior Badminton Championship is not just about records; it’s about fostering a culture of healthy living, determination, and resilience among the future champions of the sport.In the words of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy, the championship serves as an invaluable platform.---------------------------------------------------------------As we celebrate the successful culmination of the 7th edition of PNB MetLife Junior Badminton Championship , we take pride in surpassing our own world record for highest participation and for being recognized by World Record Certification Agency. Beyond the records, JBC represents a significant milestone in our mission to lay the groundwork for India’ s glory and success on the international badminton stage by creating a pan-India badminton ecosystem that nurtures champions at the grassroots levelThis year has been especially remarkable for PNB MetLife JBC as we joined hands with world champions Chirag Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy as JBC Mentors for the young talents associated with this tournament. They have played a pivotal role in inspiring young shuttlers to dream big and elevate their game and skills. We are eager for the next edition to unfold in our journey of unveiling the latent badminton potential across our nation and preparing them for global excellenceIt’s inspiring to witness the boundless talent and enthusiasm within our young athletes. My journey as JBC mentor has been incredibly fulfilling, as I got the opportunity to guide these budding champions and witness the journey of these young badminton stars. This championship is more than a competition; it is a platform that nurtures dreams, ignites aspirations, and, I believe, it is laying the foundation for future gold medalists in the makingTournaments like these serve as an invaluable platform for nurturing and harnessing the potential of our country’s young badminton stars. Witnessing the enthusiasm, passion, and skill displayed by these emerging shuttlers reinforces the belief that our country has an immense reservoir of talent. My association as a JBC mentor has been a source of immense pride, particularly given the role that the championship is playing in creating an incredible platform that is serving as a powerful catalyst, empowering young players and bolstering their confidence to become future champions
Article Summary: The 7th pnb metlife junior badminton championship shattered records with over 8,200 young talent nationwide. The grand finale unfolded at the indira gandhi indoor stadium in new delhi, where the air was thick with competition, camaraderie, and the unmistakable passion for badminton.
